name: Jungle Rot
storyline:
In 1970, the United States government deployed REAPER (Rapid Engagement and Precision Elimination Regiment) deep into the jungles of Vietnam.
Armed with an experimental, mutagenic toxin designed to help turn the tide of the war, REAPER's helicopter crashed resulting in the contamination of surrounding areas. Unbeknownst even to those transporting it, the toxin brought on irreversible side effects...
One week has passed since REAPER's unfortunate incident. You play as John Crackhorn, a Sergeant in the United States Marine Corps who has been tasked with finding and rescuing any remaining survivors from the crash. Unfortunately for Sgt. Crackhorn, his own helicopter gets shot down over enemy territory and he is left to face groups of flesh eating zombies and other terrifying monstrosities that defy the laws of biology.
summary: Jungle Rot is a fixed-camera survival horror game that makes use of pre-rendered graphics to deliver the most cutting edge horror experience possible in 1999. Manage your resources wisely, solve puzzles and fight your way through undead monsters hungry for your flesh!
